provenance.note: the StopOnNthArg boundary check is placed after the empty-argument break and the double-dash early return, so an argument that lands on the boundary is consumed by those branches instead of ending flag parsing

bugs.note: the boundary check that stops flag parsing at the Nth positional sits below the empty-argument break and the -- early return in the same loop, so those two argument shapes reach their branches first; the fix moves the check to the top of the loop
